instruction: Access the desktop settings and set the screen blank delay to 10 minutes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting screen blank delay to 10 minutes (600 seconds) via desktop settings. Initial config sets idle-delay to 60 seconds. Agent must navigate settings and change to 600. Evaluator verifies idle-delay equals 'uint32 600'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: setting screen blank delay to 10 minutes (600 seconds)
Getter (get_vm_command_line) extracts the correct state by executing 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay' which is the correct gsettings key for screen blank delay
Metric (exact_match) performs appropriate exact string comparison between result and expected value
Expected value 'uint32 600\n' is semantically correct: 600 seconds = 10 minutes, and format matches gsettings output including the 'uint32' type prefix and trailing newline
No UI dependency issues: gsettings is a command-line tool that reads from the persistent configuration database (dconf), works regardless of whether Settings UI is open or closed
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction (screen blank delay = 10 minutes)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts idle-delay value -> metric compares exact match -> expected value is the correct format and value
